bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Enforced — The UK has implemented the Crypto Travel Rule, requiring Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to enhance transparency in digital asset transactions to combat financial crime.

AI Governance Changes — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards stricter AI governance, requiring financial institutions to demonstrate compliance with new risk management guidelines.

EU Banking Reporting Reform — The European Banking Authority (EBA) is proposing significant changes to supervisory reporting, aiming to simplify requirements while enhancing the effectiveness of oversight.
Modernising Regulatory Reporting — A new configuration-driven reporting model is being advocated to improve efficiency and governance in regulatory reporting for capital markets organizations.
Reimagining Chief Data Office — The role of Chief Data Officers (CDOs) is evolving to focus on delivering measurable business impact through smarter data management strategies.
